claims.claim_en: 'aw-man' is composed of the particle 'aw' (or) + the interrogative 'man' (who). The presence of 'aw' adds a contrastive/alternative nuance to the question ('or who...'), a subtlety that can be flattened in translation when rendered simply as 'Is he who...' without signaling the 'or/contrast' element.
